meaning:
ἐπ-εῖδον 2 aor. without Pres. in use;
[in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;] to regard with attention, look upon (in cl., of the gods)
1. with a view to bless: with inf., Luk.1:25 (cf. DB, 136b).
2. To punish: before ἐπί, Act.4:29.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
